title: 设计模式：暂存的记录按钮顺序只在页头预览，行菜单要保存后才跟上
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a product defect, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7119924174). Source: the Acceptance notes of PR #36815 (#36494) and its L1 record 7119889919. Part of #36359 (the design-mode epic).
Blocked-by: #36815

## What happens

In design mode, an admin who rearranges the record action order sees the staged order previewed in the record header. The grid's row menu and right-click menu keep the saved order until the arrangement is saved. So the preview of one change disagrees across surfaces on the same page.

reach: disclosed by the PR's own Acceptance notes, not measured in a browser. It reaches every admin arranging record actions in design mode once #36815 lands.

## Expected

A staged record-order arrangement previews on every surface it will govern once saved: the record header, the row menu and the right-click menu.

## Acceptance

- In design mode, a staged reorder shows in the row menu and the right-click menu before save, with a component or browser pin.
- Discarding the staged change restores the saved order on all three surfaces.

Dedupe: open issues for "row menu record order" return #36494 (in flight, the saved-order half) and nothing on the staged preview.
